cap9_start: PHYS 290 CAPUT NONUM / De sacrae Scripturae partibus
titles: CHAPTER EIGHT. On Sacred Scripture's efficacy
Question I: Whether Scripture exerts this efficacy only objectively, or also effectively
Question II: Whether the bare letter without the Spirit's illumination leads to God — denied; first reason
Question II continued: reasons II–III; seven points on salutary understanding
Question III: Whether Scripture can be sufficiently understood for salvation without prior grace-light; duplex lumen
Reasons 1–4 affirming prior grace-light: object; seeker; exhibition; opening of seals
Reasons 5–8: instrument; matter of prayers; our inability; first origin
Reasons 9–10: against Photinian error; pious antiquity against the Pelagians
Reason 11: nature's analogy; Orange II; Ambrose/Prosper; Luther; vineyard; ask, seek, knock
Inferences from what has been said: Scripture reading most useful for clergy and laity alike
Errors 2–3: forbidding vernacular Scripture; interrupting biblical reading
Errors 4–5: forbidding Bible reading to the laity; hanging Scriptures as amulets; Cap. 8 close
